tagline: ININGIZIMU AFRIKA · IMPILO YAKHO, NGENDLELA YAKHO
tracker_intro: Rekhoda umfutho wegazi noshukela egazini ukuze uzikhumbuze. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza aluhumushi imiphumela futhi aluthathi indawo yeseluleko sezempilo.
error_glucose_number: Ushukela egazini kufanele ube inombolo evumelekile.
error_glucose_positive: Ushukela egazini kufanele ube inombolo engaphezu kuka-zero futhi elinganisekayo.
error_both_pressure: Faka kokubili umfutho wegazi ophezulu nophansi.
error_required_reading: Faka umfutho wegazi noma ushukela egazini ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
cookbook_intro: Imibono yokudla okulula. Lungisa izithako ngokwezidingo zakho.
no_recipes: Azikho izindlela zokupheka ezihambisana nosesho lwakho.
general_herbal_warning:
ISAZISO ESIBALULEKILE NGOKUPHEPHA

Imithi yesintu nezithasiselo kungase kusebenzisane nemithi kadokotela.

Ungayeki, ungehlisi umthamo noma ushintshe imithi oyinikezwe udokotela ngenxa yolwazi olukulolu hlelo lokusebenza.

Uma usebenzisa imithi efana ne-metformin, i-insulin, i-warfarin, imithi yomfutho wegazi noma eminye imithi yesikhathi eside, khuluma nodokotela noma nosokhemisi ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amakhambi noma izithasiselo njalo.

Funa usizo lwezempilo oluphuthumayo uma unezimpawu ezinzima.
